import re from typing import List def find_html_tags(html_string: str) -> List[str]: """ Extract all HTML tags from the provided string using a safe, non‑greedy regular expression. Parameters ---------- html_string : str The input string containing HTML markup. Returns ------- List[str] A list of tag strings (e.g., "
", "

", "") found in the input. """ # Non‑greedy match of any characters between '<' and '>' (excluding newlines for safety). # This pattern avoids catastrophic backtracking and is efficient even on large inputs. tag_pattern = re.compile(r'<[^>]+?>', flags=re.DOTALL) return tag_pattern.findall(html_string)
